assets.name: Signal Atlas
assets.prompt:
Create a polished UI designer's module-panel concept board for OpenPatch, a native modular synthesizer application. This is an ORIGINAL panel design inspired by Eurorack, not a reproduction of a manufacturer's faceplate. Landscape composition, sharp high-resolution typography, flat straight-on view, no perspective or photographic studio mockup. Show one large portrait module on the left, fully visible top to bottom and attached to dark rack rails at BOTH top and bottom. On the right show an exact smaller duplicate of its face inside a compact dark module-browser card labeled "BROWSER PREVIEW". The large and small face MUST be identical, just scaled. Use an uncluttered charcoal backdrop.
Compare the SAME fictional dual function generator in every concept: module title "CONTOUR", bold and highly readable in the TOP LEFT, no subtitle or descriptive sentence below it, no OpenPatch branding on the panel. Two channels, left A and right B. Four LARGE tactile round rotary knobs in a 2x2 arrangement: top row RISE / RISE, second row FALL / FALL. Two medium round SHAPE knobs below those. Two obvious CYCLE buttons with generous round blinking status LEDs. Bottom has eight LARGE circular patch jacks in two rows, labels TRIG A, CV A, TRIG B, CV B, then END A, OUT A, END B, OUT B. Logical diagrams connect relevant controls without obscuring labels or interfering with the touch targets. Oversized readable functional labels, generous knob diameters and port hit targets. A short compact central live envelope display between the channel controls is allowed if layout permits. No faders, NO colored header band or colored strip across the top, no tiny decorative paragraphs, no cables covering the face. Restrained knob/port glow, never a neon toy. Functional, premium, tactile and distinctive at reduced zoom. On the board, outside the panel, include only the option number and concept name in a discreet upper left caption.

OPTION 01 — Signal Atlas
The closest to Make Noise MATHS' visual spirit: warm ivory panel, bold near-black title and functional labels, original expressive schematic linework, symmetrical signal paths drawn as friendly technical diagrams, arrows, envelope curves and brackets used as real visual navigation. Dark graphite slightly ribbed oversized knobs with white pointer lines; large satin-metal jack bezels, black centers. Small warm amber and lime activity lights. Personality through the black graphic language and unusual purposeful diagram routing, not through rainbow colors. Dense but extremely legible at a distance. No decorative manufacturer logo, no copied MATHS artwork.
